short_bio: Talk-show host, producer and media owner who ran The Oprah Winfrey Show for 25 seasons.
biography:
Oprah Winfrey was born in Kosciusko, Mississippi, and studied at Tennessee State University. She began as a news anchor in Nashville and Baltimore before moving to Chicago to host AM Chicago in 1984.

The programme was renamed The Oprah Winfrey Show in 1986 and went national. It ran until 2011. Her production company, Harpo, produced the show, and her Book Club, launched in 1996, could push a novel onto the bestseller lists.

She was Oscar-nominated for her role in The Color Purple (1985). In 2011 she launched the network OWN. She received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2013.
